Ayesai vs nicolasfmc

Format: TEF-PBL

Setup
Ayesai flipped a coin to decide who goes first.
The coin landed on heads.
Ayesai will go first.

Turn # 1 - Ayesai's Turn
Ayesai drew a card.
Ayesai played (twm_128) Dreepy to the Bench.
Ayesai shuffled their deck.

Turn # 2 - nicolasfmc's Turn
nicolasfmc drew a card.
nicolasfmc played (svi_181) Nest Ball.
nicolasfmc shuffled their deck.

Turn # 3 - Ayesai's Turn
Ayesai drew a card.

All of nicolasfmc's Pokémon are Knocked Out. Ayesai wins.
